title: Figure 1: Amorphous versus crystalline atomic structure of metals (3D renderings)
description: Two computer-rendered cubes of packed spheres compare (a) a "Crystalline" lattice with (b) an "Amorphous (glass)" random arrangement. The caption reads "Figure 1. Amorphous Versus Crystalline Structure. Schematic atomic-scale structure of crystalline (a) and amorphous (b) metals." It appears on page 1 of a 'Metallic Glasses' report section on structure.
